title: Queer People are People First: Deconstructing Sexual Identity Stereotypes in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM with gender-neutral biographies prepended with sexual identity trigger words (e.g., gay man, lesbian woman, straight man, straight woman) and evaluating the generated text using regard scores, word clouds, pointwise mutual information (PMI), and sentence embedding similarity (t-SNE/cosine similarity).
